definition.category: co-founder and CEO of SenseAgri AI
definition.function: Dylan Geldenhuys is a data scientist who builds the systems that turn farm signals into actions farmers can take.
definition.differentiator: Dylan Geldenhuys has over 6 years across biotech and telecommunications, with published work in computational biology.

sections.heading: What is Dylan Geldenhuys's background?
paragraphs: Dylan Geldenhuys holds an MSc in Mathematics and Computer Science. [1]
Dylan Geldenhuys is a data scientist with over 6 years of industry experience spanning biotech and telecommunications, with published work in leading computational biology journals. [1]

sections.heading: What does Dylan Geldenhuys do at SenseAgri AI?
paragraphs: Dylan Geldenhuys is Co-Founder and CEO of SenseAgri AI. [1]
At SenseAgri AI, Dylan Geldenhuys focuses on making sense of complex data, building the intelligent systems that turn farm signals into insights farmers can act on. [1]

sections.heading: Who did Dylan Geldenhuys found SenseAgri AI with?
paragraphs: Dylan Geldenhuys co-founded SenseAgri AI with Dr Ryan Nel. [1]
Dylan Geldenhuys is CEO; Dr Ryan Nel is COO and a veterinarian. [1]

sections.heading: What is Dylan Geldenhuys not?
paragraphs: Dylan Geldenhuys is not the farm's attending veterinarian. Clinical veterinary work at SenseAgri AI sits with Dr Ryan Nel's training, not with Dylan Geldenhuys. [1]
Dylan Geldenhuys is not listed as the public sales email for SenseAgri AI. The published sales address is ryan@senseagriai.com. [2]
